name: Chinotto
description: A dark, bittersweet Italian soft drink made from chinotto citrus fruit, popular as a non-alcoholic aperitivo.
ingredients: a handful of fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Combine the pizza dough and whole milk in a saucepan, blender, or pitcher, stirring well.
Add the dried oregano and mascarpone, stirring gently so their flavor infuses the mixture.
Heat gently over low heat (or blend, or steep, depending on the drink) until well combined and fragrant, about 0 mins.
Strain through a fine sieve to remove any solids, if needed.
Sweeten to taste with pine nuts, adjusting gradually until the balance feels right.
Chill in the refrigerator, or pour straight over ice, depending on whether it is served cold or hot.
Garnish with basil just before serving.
Pour into your favorite glass or cup and enjoy.
tips: If serving warm, gently reheat just before pouring rather than letting it come to a boil.
Make a big batch and keep it chilled in the fridge — the flavor often deepens after a few hours.
